entities.summary: Marion Gordon "Pat" Robertson was an American media mogul, televangelist, political commentator, presidential candidate, and charismatic minister. Robertson advocated a conservative Christian ideology and was known for his involvement in Republican Party politics. He was associated with the Charismatic movement within Protestant evangelicalism. He served as head of Regent University and of the Christian Broadcasting Network (CBN). Pat Robertson was a performers & entertainers from Lexington (1930-03-22, Lexington–2023-06-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
